name: Alyn Dal-Arouya
source: The youngest daughter of the family, Alyn was always something of an outlier, showing an early fascination with nature and later with magic. When Queen Remy visited Karder in prison, she mentioned that Alyn had earned her title as a magician— a remarkable achievement, as the practice had been forbidden to women for centuries.
